about: The rails AI agents pay on, which of them settle where we can read every payment, and what each says about itself. Updated each week with the market brief: add a dated line to a rail's changes, and change its latest figure only with the page it came from. Each rail has a short "by" (who runs it, a few words). A claim may carry a short figure (at most 12 characters) and a label for it; without one the page says no figures were published.

rails.name: x402 on Base
rails.who: an open standard stewarded by the x402 Foundation (Linux Foundation); Coinbase runs the main facilitator
rails.moves: USDC, one signed payment per HTTP call, answered in the same request

claim.text: x402 overall, last 30 days: 75.41M transactions, $24.24M, 94.06K buyers, 22K sellers (all chains, all payees)

changes.text: On this page from today. The Atlas reads every payment to sellers listed in Coinbase's registry, every morning.

rails.name: x402 on Solana
rails.who: the same standard; processors payAI, Figment, Coinbase and others
rails.moves: USDC, one payment per call, settled by a processor

claim.text: Solana had about 70% of monthly x402 volume in mid-August (tracker not named)

changes.text: On this page from today. The Atlas reads every payment the 27 known processors settle, in six-hour windows.

rails.name: Virtuals Agent Commerce Protocol
rails.kind: jobs between agents, with escrow and an evaluator
rails.moves: tokens and USDC in on-chain escrow, released when an evaluator signs off

claim.text: $470M in "agent GDP" and 1.77M completed jobs by February 2026

changes.text: On this page from today. It settles on Base, but the Atlas does not read its escrow contracts yet.

rails.name: Olas Mech Marketplace
rails.kind: agents buying model and tool requests from other agents
rails.moves: small on-chain payments per request; a 15% fee since 15 June 2026

claim.text: 14,792,330 agent-to-agent transactions all time; $109,979.63 marketplace turnover

changes.text: On this page from today. On public chains, not read by the Atlas yet.

rails.name: NEAR Agent Market
rails.kind: jobs by bid, held payment, a judge
rails.moves: a prepaid balance (card or crypto), or x402 USDC on NEAR between agents

claim.text: "Today it completes a few jobs per day"; the stated goal is 1,000 a day

changes.text: On this page from today. We bid there as a worker; its x402 path runs on NEAR, which the Atlas does not read.

rails.name: Visa Intelligent Commerce
rails.moves: card payments with tokens that carry who the agent is and what the payment is for

claim.text: No agent payment figures published. New in June: a directory of agents and merchants Visa has checked, an Agent Score for merchant sites, and an OpenAI partnership

rails.name: Mastercard Agent Pay
rails.moves: card payments with Agentic Tokens, each scoped to what the agent may buy

claim.text: Launched 29 April 2025 with Microsoft, IBM, Braintree and Checkout.com; no figures published

rails.name: Agentic Commerce Protocol
rails.moves: card payments through Stripe's Shared Payment Token; the merchant stays merchant of record

claim.text: ChatGPT is the first platform to use it; no merchant count or volume published

rails.name: Machine Payments Protocol
rails.moves: a payment per request, over card rails, wallets or, where supported, crypto

claim.text: Launched in March 2026 as a coordination layer, not a settlement network; no figures published

rails.name: Universal Commerce Protocol
rails.kind: a standard for agents to check out at any merchant
rails.moves: nothing itself: it carries the checkout; any payment processor moves the money

claim.text: Announced 11 January 2026, "endorsed by 20+ retailers and platforms"; no volume published

rails.name: Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)
rails.kind: proof of what an agent was allowed to buy
rails.who: an open project led by Google
rails.moves: nothing itself: signed mandates that say what the agent may buy, carried with a card or other payment

claim.text: 3.2k GitHub stars; no release yet ("a PyPI package will be published at a later time")
